Why Nelua here

Closer to the work.

The same language can own the implementation without hiding the ABI, the generated C, or the reality of the target machine.

01 / The shape of the work

Readable source.
Native boundaries.

These projects use Nelua where explicit data shapes, predictable code generation, and small native interfaces make a practical difference.

01 — REPLACETake over a C symbol while the system libc continues to provide everything else.
02 — GENERATEKeep typed logic in Nelua and ship generated C with the release.
03 — CONNECTPut a narrow native codec between firmware protocols and browser code.
Built with Nelua

Three jobs. One language.

A working sample from projects with real source, build, or release evidence.

01 / LIBC

Nelibc

A C library rebuilt piece by piece in Nelua. Hybrid archives let Nelibc replace selected symbols while glibc or musl fills the rest.

ABI · runtime↗02 / FIRMWARE

Atlas Firmware

Typed Service V1 codecs and the schedule-record core are maintained in Nelua, generated to C, and ABI-checked in the firmware release path.

protocol · embedded↗03 / BRIDGE

Atlas Webware Bridge

A bounded ATB1 frame validator written in Nelua, bridging strict native protocol input to browser-facing field control.
